subject: STABLE lowering-opus c6n-2: 4x MSAA admitted (one JM job per 4x pass), tile-buffer guard, MRT/MSAA batching, face culling, tile stats; per-step ms/cmd estimates
body:
Hashes (shared files hold others' hunks too): bridge.c 4b3f8e25 .h c4abc8eb; render.c 20821822 .h 1dcb4d10; nord2_render_pass.inc 3941cbb7; compositor_submit.inc c4ced9ba; render_encoder.inc a7def5e4; render_pipeline.inc d7b22e7c; compute_frontend.m c09aa8d1; draw_reorder.inc 75dc225f; tests bridge 59ebf60f render 20c14ec7; harness host_test_vs_texture.py (3-draw 4x check).
Verified (host only): bridge test 18 PASS x3 (trace 0/1, extent 0; MSAA batch, lone-4x-Load refusal, MRT LOAD/batch, extent, tile stats); render oracle PASS (+cull bits, +tib guard, +MRT frame preload); iOS -Werror syntax compute_frontend.m x3 variants + ARM64 bridge/render rc=0; CA backboardd PF0/PF1 PASS; run_host_tests 55 PASS up to the new api-surface stanza (ASan SEGV in objc_msg_lookup there, not mine). Not green, NOT mine: render harness aborts in test_blit_completeness (fence/blit, api-surface) before my MSAA step; integration inert-pass build: nord2_render_pass.inc:145 calls n2r_rt_load_exact with no declaration in the standalone test (someone's new hunk in my file - texture?); legacy_sampler link needs -lBlocksRuntime. Will rerun when those land.
Also: render_pass span refusal now prints rt/fmt/size/row/offset/bytes/len (c6l had 1 unexplained 'outside target span').
Per-step estimates, ms per command at 350 MHz (device unknowns stated):
#7 tile bound (default ON, NORD2_METAL_EXTENT=0 A/B): -0 .. -8 central on frame_bench ca200 (31.4->22.9 GPU ms/frame); c6l has 6.9/cmd in-pass split jobs (memfetch 3.18 + mrt 3.72) that are full-screen LOAD jobs whose draws cover a CA layer: if layers cover ~15-50% => ~-4..-6 ms/cmd; TEGU_PERF_RT tiles=jobs/target/frag measures it directly.
MSAA 4x: correctness/coverage (siriChip/shadowGen/compositeSphere pipelines now created; a 4x pass = 1 job) ~0 perf.
Step B MRT (bridge+compositor ready; render_encoder continuation patch awaits encode-cpu ACK): -2..-3 ms/cmd when wired (mrt splits 3.72/cmd x ~0.8 ms). Needs PF=1.
Reorder (off by default; TEGU_DRAW_REORDER=1 in-pass, =2 cross-pass): frame_bench 0 moves; device 0..-3 ms/cmd if c6l 'mrt' splits are per-RT alternations.
Cull: correctness (3D clients), 0.
#12 trap: ~-0.5 ms/cmd CPU, waiting for KA's ABI answer. #9 AFBC: -1..-2 ms, not started (needs texture-opus).
Depth/stencil (api-surface gap): not started; SpringBoard c6l logs show no depth refusals, so I rank it after MRT wiring/trap.
